paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption:
(d) The performance on Qwen2.5.

 The performance of knowledge probing after editing with  different editing methods on BioGPT and Llama2, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy percentage (ACC) across different methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a exponential scale, with values ranging from 1 to 1000 and tick labels at approximately 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale, with values ranging from 60 to 80 percent and tick labels at intervals of 5 percent. The plot displays six lines: a black line with circular markers representing "Base", starting at approximately 64% ACC at 5 and increasing to about 71% slightly beyond 10^3; a blue line with downward-pointing triangular markers for "FT", starting at around 65% and rising to roughly 73% slightly beyond 10^3; a red line with upward-pointing triangular markers for "IKE", beginning at about 67% and increasing to nearly 75% slightly beyond 10^3; a brown line with diamond markers for "MEND", starting around 68% at 5 and ending near 78% slightly beyond 10^3; a purple line with pentagon markers for "MEMIT", beginning at approximately 70% at 5 and ending around 78% slightly beyond 10^3; and a green line with square markers for "ROME", starting at about 75% at 5 and rising steadily to approximately 83% slightly beyond 10^3. Each line follows a generally upward trend as the co-occurrence number increases. No lines intersect each other. A legend is given in top left, describing the line and color.
